hardware.notes: Measured on Lambda Cloud / NVIDIA A10 (single GPU). Driver 580.x, CUDA 13.x per instance image.

open_division_justification.summary: INT4 Lloyd-Max KV cache + 1-bit Rademacher QJL residual, Hadamard WHT pre-rotation, fused Triton omni_attn with O(1) Multi-LoRA pointer dispatch. This is a custom recommendation-serving attention path (not the MLPerf closed DLRMv3 reference model).
open_division_justification.codec: 3.37x compression (4.75 bits/element) vs BF16 baselines in repo benchmark
